title: alchemilla xanthochlora f. amphitricha

The marsh alchemilla is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments such as skin conditions and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla xanthochlora f. amphitricha include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system.
